Terms & Conditions

  • Payment: 50% advance before work starts, 50% on final delivery.
  • Extra revisions: $10 per additional round beyond the plan.
  • Rush delivery: +25% fee for turnaround faster than listed.
  • Source files: included only in Premium tier, or on request for a small fee.
  • Usage rights: full commercial rights transfer after final payment is received.
  • Cancellation: no refund once work has started; partial refund only before work begins.
  • Content & assets: client to share raw footage, brand info or references at project start.
  • Communication: updates shared via WhatsApp/Email; response within 24 hours on working days.
